_comment: outdoor-bosses (Docs/OutdoorBosses.md): Eric's Boss markers in MapLayout.json are WORLD BOSSES, always there, one different race boss per marker, the same boss in both realms. Which boss: the marker's own "kind" (layout editor inspector: OUTDOOR BOSS < >), else byMarker (marker name -> boss id), else roster in marker order. Boss ids are the race bosses of Races.json (warlord / colossus of each race). respawnSeconds: a slain boss returns to its marker after this long (0 = it stays dead for the match). waveBossesAtMarkers: false = wave bosses spawn at their wave's monster spawn (the markers are the world bosses' lairs). strengthWave: configured like a wave boss of at least this global wave (the live wave when later), times healthMultiplier / damageMultiplier. lootTier: the challenge tier the boss shows and its pack-completion loot rolls at (it also rolls the lane-boss table). goldMultiplier: on the boss bounty (10x the current mob value). The leash is MonsterLeash.json's boss radius around the marker. cire.OutdoorBosses reload re-reads this file.
